evidence: Liber precum pūblicārum (1560), the Latin Book of Common Prayer
terms.comment: A plain description: precēs are prayers (Cic.). The Orthodox book of the Hours is the Horologion, the Western one the breviary.

terms.gloss: the breviary, the Western book of the Hours
evidence: Sen. Ep. 39.1, of a summary (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically a summary or abridgment (Sen., Suet.).

sources: Lewis & Short: liber · Lewis & Short: prex · Lewis & Short: breviarius
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. breviary. Traupman and Levi–Bini have no word.
The 1560 Latin version of the Book of Common Prayer, Liber precum pūblicārum: its title as library catalogues give it (9 November 2026).
